obligation.title: Catalogue delivery for the Harbour trade fair
obligation.duty: Deliver 400 printed catalogues to stand B12 at the Harbour trade fair.
excuses: a strike or blockade that stops carriers serving the delivery route
an order of a public authority that closes the venue or the route
a fire, flood or storm that damages the goods or the print works

short_obligation.title: Stand signage for the Harbour trade fair
short_obligation.duty: Install the printed stand signage at stand B12 before the fair opens.

claims.strike: A national port strike began on 3 March and stopped every carrier serving the Rotterdam delivery route for two days. The printed catalogues sat at the depot until the strike ended.
claims.illness: Our print supervisor was ill for a week in February, so the second print run started late and the catalogues left the print works four days behind schedule.
claims.third: The courier we booked cancelled at short notice and the replacement could not collect the catalogues until the following morning.
claims.unruled: Strong winds closed the access road to the fairground for an afternoon, and the sign installers could not reach stand B12 until the next morning.
